jobs.meta: Tata Consultancy Services · Chennai, India · August 2024 – Present
jobs.lede: Delivering production-grade enterprise AI solutions across GCP and AWS for supply chain document automation, multi-agent insurance claims, enterprise IT support, and apparel commerce.

work.title: 📦 Streamlining Supply Chain Automation with GenAI
work.summary: When manual vendor invoice and packing slip processing started creating bottlenecks across 20+ suppliers, I architected a serverless, GCP-native document extraction pipeline tied directly into JDE ERP. By replacing brittle legacy extraction with a flexible generative AI schema framework, extraction accuracy jumped from 75% to 95%, achieving 80% end-to-end automation across unstructured supplier templates and saving 2,800–3,700 hours of manual labor per distribution center annually.

work.title: 🛡️ Architecting Trusted Multi-Agent AI for Insurance
work.tech: LangGraph | Multi-Agent Systems | AI Governance & Evaluation
work.summary: To tackle high-risk insurance claims safely, I designed a multi-agent orchestration framework built on LangGraph. The system uses deterministic guardrails, real-time PII masking, and human-in-the-loop interrupt checkpoints so adjusters can review edge cases before final decisions. To guarantee production reliability, I engineered a custom CI evaluation suite featuring full branch-coverage checks, trajectory tracking, and calibrated LLM-as-a-judge scoring.

work.title: 🔍 Unlocking Enterprise Knowledge with Secure RAG
work.tech: Hybrid Search | Access Control | High-Precision Retrieval
work.summary: To empower IT support teams, I built an enterprise ticket triage assistant capable of retrieving internal SOPs safely and instantly. By combining hybrid search (BM25 + Dense embeddings) with cross-encoder reranking, the engine achieved 95% Recall@5 and 0.81 NDCG@5. Security was built in from day one, featuring strict server-side pre-retrieval access control, dual-layer citation verification, prompt-injection defense, and confidence-gated fallback synthesis.

work.title: 👕 Driving Fashion Engagement with AI Virtual Try-On
work.tech: AWS Bedrock | Team Leadership | Dynamic Yield
work.summary: Leading a team of 5 engineers, I directed the launch of an AWS Bedrock-powered Virtual Try-On experience spanning 21 apparel categories within a Dynamic Yield environment. By transforming how shoppers visualize garments online, the feature was projected to boost conversions by 2–5% and reduce product return rates by up to 10%.

jobs.lede: A structured data-science internship focused on market research, exploratory data analysis, and predictive machine learning modeling for the electric vehicle sector.

work.title: 🌊 Maritime Data Analysis & Classification
work.summary: Engineered a maritime data analysis and tracking solution (SmartSea) leveraging Gradient Boosting to classify ship vessel types using AIS datasets from the Denmark Maritime Authority. Conducted rigorous data preprocessing, EDA, and custom feature engineering—handling missing values, outlier detection using IQR, and building features like vessel dimensions and route calculations. Designed and deployed a private blockchain network using Ganache and Solidity, developing a VesselRegistry smart contract to record immutable ship tracking details securely.

work.title: 🏥 Healthcare Market Analysis & Forecasting
work.summary: Built and evaluated predictive machine learning models in Python for healthcare market analysis, including medical cost regression models using Random Forest and Polynomial Regression. Implemented time-series forecasting with Holt-Winters and ARIMA to predict market trends and inform strategic decision-making.

work.title: ⚡ EV & eHealth Market Segmentation
work.summary: Executed market segmentation analyses for electric vehicle and eHealth industries utilizing large-scale census and survey data. Applied Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and K-Means clustering to extract primary consumer segments and identify market target strategies.

education.degree: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
